name: Metall Zug AG
summary: Metall Zug AG, through its subsidiaries, engages in the medical devices, infection control, technology cluster and infrastructure, and other businesses in Switzerland, Europe, North America, South America, the Asia Pacific, and internationally. The company develops, manufactures, and distributes devices and solutions for medical diagnosis, microsurgery, and eye training.
